title: Gemini shortcut tests — 9 November 2026
method: Each original shortcut prompt used the workshop book in a separate temporary chat. English interface selected with hl=en. Code-only responses were regenerated in the same temporary chat with Canvas and explicit rendering follow-ups. Exported HTML is unchanged and was tested in a local browser. Screenshots are native browser captures, not mock-ups.
limitations: One Workspace account and one test session; results can vary.
Canvas previews were blank in the capture browser. Five exported files were verified locally; their screenshots are not presented as in-chat previews.
The first concept-map export was incomplete; Gemini generated the complete replacement.
Scores are demonstration interactions, not evidence of learning.
Some generated apps use external styling CDNs.
Temporary chat URLs are not durable public evidence; published records contain prompts, follow-ups, outcomes, original exports and screenshots.

tests.prompt: /conceptmap Using only the attached book, create a compact interactive concept map comparing training, ordinary inference and RAG for university students. Show exactly three selectable branches: Training, Inference and RAG. Selecting a branch must reveal its labelled relationships and a chapter-grounded explanation. Include three short check questions, one per branch, with answer choices, a Check answers button, explanatory feedback and a Retry control. Keep parameter updates separate from context changes. Use a compact native interactive widget, not an image. Answer in English.
tests.observed: Regenerated in Canvas; the first export was incomplete. Complete unmodified replacement verified locally: Training, Inference and RAG branches, three checked answers and feedback.
followUps: Render the activity from my original prompt above as a working Canvas app with an interactive Preview, rather than source code in the chat. Preserve all the requirements and controls in that original prompt and use only the attached book. Use English for all content and controls.
